frozen_before_measurement.candidate_rule: Useful on this exact workload only if success improves with <=10% mean-time worsening OR mean time improves >=10% with success loss <=0.02; otherwise mixed/null.

conditional_estimator.alternative_cost: mean min(transversal time-to-success-or-exhaustion, evaluation remaining budget)
conditional_estimator.alternative_success: fraction of calibration transversal traces successful within evaluation remaining budget
conditional_estimator.checkpoint: after each completed failed direct configuration
conditional_estimator.direct_conditioning: calibration episodes still unsuccessful after same direct-config index k
conditional_estimator.direct_remaining_cost: mean over survivors of min(later direct time-to-success-or-exhaustion minus cumulative time at k, evaluation remaining budget), clipped at zero
conditional_estimator.direct_success_before_deadline: among same-index calibration survivors, fraction with later direct success whose remaining time from checkpoint k is <= current evaluation remaining budget
conditional_estimator.raw_advantage: alternative_utility > direct_utility + hysteresis OR (direct_success_probability < deadline_success_floor AND alternative_success_probability >= deadline_success_floor)
conditional_estimator.switch: two consecutive raw-advantage checkpoints; no mid-config interruption

frozen_before_measurement.confirmation_lock: After calibration rows are durable and derived snapshot is committed/read back, confirmation may run only with the exact frozen harness and derived snapshot; no threshold, family, estimator, candidate-rule, or seed changes.

measurement_persistence.durable_boundary: Commit/read back all 12 raw calibration rows and the derived snapshot before starting any confirmation episode; commit/read back all 18 raw confirmation rows before policy simulation.
measurement_persistence.hard_fail: Duplicate seed, row digest mismatch, missing planned seed, harness digest mismatch, dataset digest mismatch, library mismatch, or derived digest mismatch => no confirmation claim.
measurement_persistence.local_write: append + flush + fsync after every episode
measurement_persistence.raw_episode_format: canonical JSONL, one complete episode row with row_sha256

public_existing_solution_audit.DVC: Public docs support reproducing exact code/data for experiments through Git plus DVC-tracked artifacts; useful replay pattern but not a substitute for freezing this statistical decision rule before measurement.
public_existing_solution_audit.MLflow: Public docs expose durable run metadata and arbitrary artifacts; useful storage substrate but replay completeness still depends on explicitly logging the executable harness/raw rows/derived snapshot.
public_existing_solution_audit.Sacred: Public docs show automatic capture of final config, source files, dependencies, Git commit/dirty state; useful provenance pattern but not itself this pre-measurement confirmation lock.

purpose: Replay-complete repair preregistration created before any timing measurement for the repaired experiment.

repair_reason.claim_scope: This is a protocol repair, not negative evidence against the sequence-104 performance candidate.
repair_reason.legacy_confirmation_seeds_7000_7017_poli: Do not consume or reinterpret; the preregistered calibration input they require is not durably replayable.

scope_limit: One bundled public dataset, two fixed model families, one host/runtime; timings are host-specific and do not establish transfer.
